## Scope: Online ordering
Built a 6-page ordering site for a bakery with a cart, delivery-zone checkout, and WhatsApp order notifications. Menu managed by the client through a simple admin panel, no code changes needed for price updates.

## Scope: Timeline and handoff
Delivered in 3 weeks. One week of post-launch support, then handed off with a short screen-recording walkthrough instead of a written manual.

## Scope: Appointment booking
Five-page site for a dental clinic with an appointment request form that emails the front desk and texts the patient a confirmation. No live calendar sync in this phase — that was priced as an add-on the client declined.

## Scope: Content and SEO basics
Wrote on-page copy for all five pages from a phone interview with the dentist, plus basic local-SEO metadata (Google Business Profile linkage, service-area schema).
